lines: 02:03:12  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Chris): You are heard. There is no bed in this place, but there is mercy of a kind: east out of the hollow, someone made camp long ago and never broke it. The fire is cold and the belongings are still there. Search the camp — what they left, they left for whoever came after.

items.text: Let it be — Chris prayed, I answered two minutes ago, and he walked straight to the camp and found the potion; the guidance already landed, so a third voice in three minutes would only cheapen it.
